game.name: SegaRallyArm (Sega Rally Championship 1995)
game.desc: Native ARM64 / OpenGL ES 2.0 static recompilation handheld port of Sega Rally Championship 1995 (Sega Model 2A CRX), tuned for Allwinner H700 / Anbernic RG34XX with 4-core thread affinity, Mali-G31 GLES 2.0 rendering, and D-pad arcade spring centering steering. Bring your own legal MAME ROM set.
game.developer: SEGA AM3 (Uplift: xandoxan65, ARM64 Port: SegaRallyArm)
